title: Ratification -- one decider's answer on every slate ticket (R34, R36 round 5)
x_purpose: Each decider answers per ticket: AGREE, AGREE_WITH_RESERVATION (say the reservation), or OBJECT with the ONE thing that would clear it. Code counts OBJECT answers on the FINAL ratification (pma_pipeline.py ratify-count): 0 = AGREED; 1 to 3 = CONTESTED (listed, objections printed); 4 or more of 7 (half or more of the deciders present) = DROPPED (off the list, still tracked). After a Steenbarger hold the held tickets are ratified again once (forms/ratify2/), and those answers replace the first for those tickets only.

round.x_note: 1 = first ratification, 2 = after a hold (held tickets only)

objection.x_note: REQUIRED on OBJECT: the one thing wrong with the ticket as written

would_clear.x_note: REQUIRED on OBJECT: the one thing that would clear the objection

x_registrar_extra_checks: with --slate: the ticker set equals the slate's exactly (no missing, no extra)
OBJECT using a bracket as the disqualifier => REJECT (R1)
a ratification from a non-decider is REJECTED here and ignored loudly by ratify-count
